name: Hosea Kutako International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 08/26, is 4,569 m x 45 m asphalt; 15/33 is 1,523 m x 30 m

hours.v: aerodrome open Mon-Sun 0300-1930 UTC (05:00-21:30 local); ATS and security H24

customs.v: customs and immigration as aerodrome hours: 0300-1930 UTC (05:00-21:30 local)
customs.quote: Customs and immigration: As AD Administration

curfew.v: outside 0300-1930 UTC (21:30-05:00 local) operations need an application 48 hours ahead to the airport manager, with a surcharge of N$11,406 per hour (not for emergencies)
curfew.quote: Aircraft wishing to operate outside the operation hours should apply 48HR in advance to APM and a surcharge of N$11,406 per hour thereof will apply.

permits.v: an aircraft new to the airport must apply in writing through the Senior Airport Manager (new aircraft application form) and may operate only after NAC approval
permits.quote: may only operate the new aircraft upon approval by the NAC.

notes: Read: Namibia AIP Part AD (NCAA), cover 28 NOV 2024 AIRAC A03/2024 with amendments to A04/2026 (effective 26 NOV 2026); FYWH AD 2 pages mostly dated 26 NOV 2026 (AIRAC A04/2026) (https://www.ncaa.com.na/publications/aeronautical-information/aeronautical-information-publication/aips/Aerodrome.pdf). Hours 0300-1930 converted assuming UTC per AIP convention (Namibia UTC+2); the extract did not itself say UTC - confirm. Customs/handling/fuelling hours given as 'As AD Administration'. AD 2.20 also: 'No simultaneous movements of any aircraft type or code are permitted during night operations.' The 'curfew' entry is the after-hours approval rule, not a ban. Quotes were extracted by a summarising reader; the after-hours quote joins two consecutive source lines. Aerodrome certified by NCAA 05 Dec 2025 (AD 1.5). IATA code not stated.
